The file focus_billing.csv is a FOCUS-format (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification) daily cost export. Unless stated otherwise, 'spend' means the sum of BilledCost, and rows of every ChargeCategory are included. Which single ResourceId had the largest absolute increase in spend from 2026-08 to 2026-09, and by how much (rounded to 2 decimals)?

Data files in your working directory: focus_billing.csv.

Required final answer format (JSON inside <answer></answer> tags):
{"resource_id": "<ResourceId>", "increase": <number>}

tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
print(df['BillingPeriodStart'].unique())
print(df['ChargePeriodStart'].min(), df['ChargePeriodStart'].max())

df['month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['BillingPeriodStart']).dt.to_period('M')
piv = df.groupby(['ResourceId','month'])['BilledCost'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
piv['delta'] = piv.get(pd.Period('2026-09','M'), 0) - piv.get(pd.Period('2026-08','M'), 0)
print(piv['delta'].abs().sort_values(ascending=False).head())

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('focus_billing.csv')
df['month'] = pd.to_datetime(df['BillingPeriodStart']).dt.to_period('M')
piv = df.groupby(['ResourceId','month'])['BilledCost'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
piv['delta'] = piv[pd.Period('2026-09','M')] - piv[pd.Period('2026-08','M')]
top = piv['delta'].abs().idxmax()
print(top, round(piv.loc[top,'delta'],2))
